title: Depth-Linked Residual Tokens for Multimodal Retrieval and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Iterative architectures such as looped language models improve parameter efficiency and reasoning capacity of transformers, yet their sequential backbone iterations introduce substantial computational latency. Conversely, parallelizable learnable special tokens (such as the register tokens in Vision Transformer) enable efficient single-pass inference, but often suffer from the absence of sequential refinement and exhibit redundant representations across tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce Depth-Linked Residual Tokens (DepThink), an efficient framework designed for multimodal retrieval and generation. Operating within a single pre-filling forward pass, DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens whose hidden states are coupled through a lightweight, learnable residual recurrence. This mechanism enables each residual token to progressively capture complementary information missed by preceding tokens. Theoreti

translated_title: 面向多模态检索与生成的深度关联残差标记
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26752v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：诸如循环语言模型等迭代式架构提升了Transformer的参数效率与推理能力，但其串行的主干迭代会引入显著的计算延迟。相反，可并行的可学习特殊标记（例如Vision Transformer中的register标记）能够实现高效的单次前向推理，但往往缺乏串行式的逐步精炼，且各标记之间常表现出冗余的表示。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了深度关联残差标记（DepThink），一个面向多模态检索与生成的高效框架。DepThink在单次预填充前向传播中运行，附加一串K个可学习的残差标记，其隐藏状态通过一个轻量级的可学习残差递归相互耦合。该机制使每个残差标记能够逐步捕捉前序标记所遗漏的互补信息。理论（分析）
tldr: 提出DepThink框架，在单次前向传播中通过轻量级可学习残差递归将一串残差标记的隐藏状态相互耦合，使其逐步捕捉互补信息，从而兼得迭代架构的逐步精炼能力与并行单次推理的高效性，服务于多模态检索与生成。
en_tdlr: DepThink appends a sequence of K learnable residual tokens coupled via lightweight learnable residual recurrence in a single pre-filling forward pass, enabling progressive capture of complementary information and combining the refinement of iterative architectures with efficient parallel inference for multimodal retrieval and generation.
